## BODY LICE (PEDICULOSIS CORPORIS)
Lice are parasitic insects. Human lice survive by feeding on human blood.
Body lice proliferate in places where crowding of persons with poor hygiene is
common, especially homeless persons.
Infested clothing and bed linen should be heat washed or discarded.
Itching is the most common symptom, but some patients present only with
excoriations and inflammation on the neck and trunk.

## Treatment
A repeat application may be used if live lice are seen 7-10 days after
treatment.
